correctness.rationale: With nonzero F2^3 labels a,b and a·b=0, the incidence graph has 21 edges and transpose is an involutive graph automorphism. Fixed barycentric coordinates are constant on vertex orbits, so the geometric fixed realization is PL homeomorphic to the simplicial orbit complex whose faces correspond to unions of compatible edge orbits. Twelve admissible orbits reduce to the looped seven-label disjoint-support model. Independently implemented bitmask enumeration yields 138 orbit faces including empty, f=(12,45,59,21), and independently enumerates all 3462 original matchings with exactly the same 138 setwise fixed faces. Rebuilding the staged 12-toggle pairing gives 66 pairs and five unmatched cells of dimensions (0,2,2,2,2); a complete 351-cover directed Hasse graph visits all 137 nonempty faces in topological order, proving acyclicity. Discrete Morse yields a CW complex with one 0-cell, no 1-cells, four 2-cells and no others; every 2-cell attaches to the 0-cell, proving an integral ∨4 S². Finite exhaustive certificate is complete for this single finite graph, not a graph-family theorem. The repository verifier code and certificate were inspected, not merely its success log.
